data.binary_sensors: Binary Sensors (motion, occupancy - for room activity)

data_description.enabled: When disabled, this area will be ignored by the integration
data_description.track_only_when_occupied: When enabled, this area only participates in thermostat decisions and minimum-vent selection while it is currently occupied. When unoccupied, its vents are closed even if the room temperature is beyond the normal critical threshold.
data_description.contact_sensors: Door/window sensors that will pause the thermostat when left open too long
data_description.binary_sensors: Motion, occupancy, and other binary sensors for room activity detection
data_description.predictive_activity_entities: Room-specific entities that may add heat load, such as PCs, TVs, amplifiers, or appliances. Predictive Comfort can learn their temperature impact from recorder history.
data_description.vents: Cover entities (vents) in this area. Can include individual vents or vent groups.
data_description.area_vent_open_delay_seconds: Override the global vent open delay for this area. Leave empty to use global setting.

predictive_comfort.title: Predictive Comfort Mode
predictive_comfort.description: Use weather forecasts, humidity, room temperatures, and learned device heat loads to proactively prepare the house. Automatic setpoint changes and HVAC mode changes are disabled by default.

data_description.predictive_comfort_enabled: Evaluate proactive comfort recommendations. This only creates diagnostics unless automatic adjustment is also enabled.
data_description.predictive_auto_adjust: Permit Predictive Comfort to call climate.set_temperature. Skipped while contact sensors are open or the integration is paused.
data_description.predictive_allow_hvac_mode_change: Permit Predictive Comfort to change between supported heat/cool modes before setting a proactive target.
data_description.predictive_allow_away: Permit Predictive Comfort to automatically pre-heat or pre-cool while away mode is active. Off by default so an empty house is not prepared for normal comfort unless explicitly allowed.
data_description.predictive_weather_entity: Shared weather source for the house. Leave blank to use another configured entry's weather source or auto-detect weather.pirate_weather / weather.forecast_home.
data_description.predictive_temperature_sensors: Optional global indoor temperature sensors. If blank, enabled area temperature sensors are used.
data_description.predictive_humidity_sensors: Humidity sensors that increase perceived heat pressure above the comfort baseline.
data_description.predictive_activity_entities: Global heat-load entities. Add room-specific devices in each area's options when possible.
data_description.predictive_comfort_low: Lower end of the desired comfort band.
data_description.predictive_comfort_high: Upper end of the desired comfort band.
data_description.predictive_lookahead_hours: How far ahead weather forecast data should influence the prediction.
data_description.predictive_trigger_margin: How far beyond the comfort band the prediction must move before recommending pre-heat or pre-cool.
data_description.predictive_precool_offset: How far below comfort high to set cooling when pre-cooling.
data_description.predictive_preheat_offset: How far above comfort low to set heating when pre-heating.
data_description.predictive_outdoor_influence: Weight applied to forecast heat/cold pressure.
data_description.predictive_trend_weight: Additional weight applied only to the current-to-forecast warming trend so far-ahead highs do not count the same as immediate heat.
data_description.predictive_humidity_sensitivity: Degrees of perceived heat added per humidity point above baseline.
data_description.predictive_activity_heat_gain: Fallback heat gain per active heat-load entity when history learning has not learned enough yet.
data_description.predictive_rain_cooling: Cooling effect subtracted when rain or precipitation is forecast.
data_description.predictive_evaluation_interval: How often to reevaluate predictions even if no tracked entity changes.
data_description.predictive_min_adjustment_interval: Rate limit between automatic thermostat setpoint adjustments.
data_description.predictive_history_learning_enabled: Use recorder history to learn whether heat-load entities meaningfully change room temperature.
data_description.predictive_history_lookback_days: How much recorder history to inspect for heat-load learning.
data_description.predictive_learning_window_minutes: Temperature comparison window after a heat-load entity activates.
data_description.predictive_learning_refresh_interval: How often history learning may refresh.
data_description.predictive_min_learning_samples: Minimum activation samples required before a learned gain is considered valid.
data_description.predictive_meaningful_temp_delta: Minimum average temperature increase required to count as meaningful.
data_description.predictive_max_learned_heat_gain: Upper bound for learned heat gain from one entity.

global_settings.title: Global Settings
global_settings.description: Configure occupancy detection, thermostat control, timeouts, and notifications. Notification messages support Jinja2 templates.

data_description.min_occupancy_minutes: A room must be continuously occupied for this many minutes before it is considered active for heating/cooling. This prevents short visits from affecting thermostat behavior.
data_description.grace_period_minutes: When an active room becomes unoccupied, it will remain active for this many minutes before deactivating. If the room becomes occupied again during this period, it stays active. Minimum: 2 minutes.
data_description.temperature_deadband: Temperature tolerance for satiation. A room is considered satiated when its temperature is within this amount of the target. This prevents rapid on/off cycling.
data_description.min_cycle_on_minutes: Minimum time the thermostat must stay ON before it can be turned off. Protects HVAC equipment from rapid cycling.
data_description.min_cycle_off_minutes: Minimum time the thermostat must stay OFF before it can be turned on. Protects HVAC equipment from rapid cycling.
data_description.unoccupied_heating_threshold: Degrees below heat target that triggers heating even in unoccupied rooms. Protects rooms from getting too cold when no one is there.
data_description.unoccupied_cooling_threshold: Degrees above cool target that triggers cooling even in unoccupied rooms. Protects rooms from getting too hot when no one is there.
data_description.heating_boost_offset: Degrees to add to the heat setpoint when turning on the thermostat. This overcomes the thermostat's internal deadband to ensure it actually calls for heat. For example, if your ecobee isn't heating because it thinks it's already at temperature, set this to 2-3°.
data_description.cooling_boost_offset: Degrees to subtract from the cool setpoint when turning on the thermostat. This overcomes the thermostat's internal deadband to ensure it actually calls for cooling.
data_description.min_vents_open: Minimum number of vents that must remain open to prevent HVAC back pressure. The effective minimum also respects the maximum closed-vent budget.
data_description.max_closed_vents: Maximum number of physical vents that may be closed at the same time. Vent groups count by their member vents, so a two-vent room consumes two closed slots.
data_description.vent_open_delay_seconds: Seconds after a room becomes occupied before its vents open. Prevents vents from opening during brief pass-throughs.
data_description.vent_debounce_seconds: Minimum time between vent state changes for the same vent. Prevents rapid open/close cycling.
data_description.open_timeout: Minutes a sensor must be open before pausing thermostat
data_description.close_timeout: Minutes all sensors must be closed before resuming thermostat
data_description.notify_service: Service to call for notifications (e.g., notify.mobile_app_phone). Leave empty to disable notifications.
data_description.notify_message_paused: Message when paused. Available variables: {{ trigger_sensor_name }}, {{ open_count }}, {{ open_timeout }}, {{ thermostat_name }}
data_description.notify_message_resumed: Message when resumed. Available variables: {{ trigger_sensor_name }}, {{ close_timeout }}, {{ previous_mode }}, {{ thermostat_name }}
data_description.notification_tag: Tag for persistent/replaceable notifications (allows updates to same notification)
data_description.away_presence_entity: Select a person, group, or presence binary sensor. When the entity state is 'not_home', 'off', or 'false', away mode will activate and adjust temperatures.
data_description.vacation_mode_entity: Select an input boolean, binary sensor, or switch that is on while vacation mode is active. Predictive Comfort automatic HVAC adjustments are skipped during vacation mode, even when away adjustments are allowed.
data_description.away_heat_temp_diff: Degrees to lower the heat target when away (negative value). For example, -3 means heat targets will be 3° lower when everyone is away.
data_description.away_cool_temp_diff: Degrees to raise the cool target when away (positive value). For example, 3 means cool targets will be 3° higher when everyone is away.
